content:
{
  "root_cause": "The focus trap incorrectly includes hidden elements (e.g., buttons with display:none) in the focusable node list, causing the last focusable element to be misidentified and allowing Tab to escape the modal.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify getFocusableNodes to filter out elements that are not visually rendered (display:none or visibility hidden) using computed styles, ensuring only truly focusable nodes are considered for wrapping.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "lib/src/index.js",
      "sha256": "41dd4805c18bcc8ad0daec586c08042986c4d2e0f06b3d70183ec0c045c43b6c",
      "before": "    getFocusableNodes () {\n      const nodes = this.modal.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS)\n      return Array(...nodes)\n    }",
      "after": "    getFocusableNodes () {\n      const nodes = this.modal.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS)\n      return Array.from(nodes).filter(node => {\n        const style = window.getComputedStyle(node)\n        return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden'\n      })\n    }"
  },
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Tabbing within the modal will now properly wrap to the first focusable element when reaching the last, keeping focus inside the dialog for keyboard users.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential performance impact due to computing styles for each focusable node on each keydown.",
    "Risk of incorrectly hiding nodes that are programmatically focusable but temporarily off-screen.",
    "Possible interference with custom elements that rely on JS for visibility."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that tabbing from the last visible control (Upload button) loops back to the first control (filename input) and does not move to the help link.",
    "Confirm that Escape still closes the dialog and returns focus to the triggering button.",
    "Ensure screen reader announcement of modal content remains unchanged.",
    "Check that the hidden retry button remains non-focusable and does not affect tab order."
  ]
}
